# Greentrip Technologies

> Greentrip Technologies designs, builds, and operates production AI systems for enterprises. The public site is https://greentripai.com. Contact support@greentripai.com.

Greentrip is an applied AI consultancy. The marketing site describes services, solution blueprints, case studies, and GTDoc, an AI-powered dental clinic operating system.

## Pages

- [Home](https://greentripai.com/): What Greentrip Technologies builds and how engagements start.
- [Services](https://greentripai.com/services): Agentic systems, LLM apps, RAG, computer vision, automation, predictive ML, MLOps, safety, and advisory.
- [Solutions](https://greentripai.com/solutions): Deployable AI blueprints, including GTDoc.
- [GTDoc](https://greentripai.com/gtdoc): AI dental clinic management product. Early access collects email and phone.
- [Case studies](https://greentripai.com/case-studies): Illustrative engagement outcomes.
- [About](https://greentripai.com/about): How the team works.
- [Contact](https://greentripai.com/contact): Project, support, and help requests.

## Contact

- [Email support](mailto:support@greentripai.com): Sales, support, and partnership inquiries.
